summary: InPoint Commercial Real Estate Income filed a routine Item 8.01 8-K on September 15, 2026, disclosing its monthly net asset value per share as of August 31, 2026, calculated under board-approved valuation guidelines. Aggregate NAV attributable to common stock was approximately $138.5 million, or $13.6882 per share across 10.12 million shares, with commercial mortgage loans of $301.7 million, real estate owned of $153.6 million, and $89.6 million of preferred stock. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation event is present; this is an ordinary NAV update, not a deal.
